description: This file contains the implementation of the DataTables Select extension, providing API methods, event handlers, and button integrations for row, column, and cell selection within DataTables. It includes initialization, event management, selection logic, and UI updates.

methods.name: DataTable.select.init
methods.description: Initializes selection options and event handlers for a DataTable instance.

methods.name: DataTable.select.style
methods.description: Gets or sets the selection interaction style ('none', 'single', 'multi', 'os', 'api').

methods.name: DataTable.select.items
methods.description: Gets or sets the items that can be selected ('rows', 'columns', 'cells').

methods.name: DataTable.select.selector
methods.description: Gets or sets the CSS selector for selectable items within the table.

methods.name: DataTable.select.info
methods.description: Enables or disables the display of selection info in the table.

methods.name: DataTable.select.blurable
methods.description: Enables or disables blurring (deselecting) when clicking outside the table.

methods.name: DataTable.select.destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event handlers and disables selection features.
